ocrRawText:
BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
2 cups flour          3 tbsps brown sugar
3 tsps baking powder  1/4 tsp salt
1 egg                 1 cup milk
1/4 cup melted butter 1 cup fresh blueberries
2 tbsps sugar
Mix together dry ingredients. In another
bowl mix egg, melted butter, and milk. Add to
dry ingredients. Stir in blueberries.
Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake 425dd
20 to 25 min. Serve warm
